nodes.label: VERITAS: Cryptographic Traceability & Grounded Entailment in Scientific AI
nodes.panel_payload: Comprehensive research paper introducing VERITAS, an architecture engineered to solve LLM hallucination and unverified attribution in scientific literature review through deterministic cryptographic provenance and post-generation NLI claim entailment evaluation.

nodes.label: 1. Multi-Column PDF Decomposition & Coordinate Mapping
nodes.panel_payload: Details the layout-aware document processing pipeline. Preserves multi-column reading order and maps every extracted text segment to normalized bounding box coordinates across physical document pages.

nodes.label: 1.1 Bounding Box Normalization & Layout Analysis
nodes.panel_payload: Employs PyMuPDF page geometry analysis to extract reading blocks with normalized coordinates [x0, y0, x1, y1], distinguishing headers, block math equations, tables, and figure captions from body prose.

nodes.label: Flashcard: Cryptographic SHA-256 Deduplication
nodes.panel_payload:
Q: How does VERITAS prevent duplicate storage and processing of preprints?
A: Incoming documents generate a deterministic SHA-256 binary hash upon upload. Existing hashes trigger immediate pointer reuse, bypassing redundant embedding operations.

nodes.label: 2. Hybrid Semantic Retrieval & Reciprocal Rank Fusion
nodes.panel_payload: Combines dense vector embeddings (Google Gemini text-embedding-004) with sparse BM25 lexical search using Qdrant vector database, resolving vocabulary mismatch while guaranteeing precision on academic terminology.

nodes.label: 2.1 Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Ranking
nodes.panel_payload: Calculates unified chunk relevance using the RRF algorithm: Score(d) = sum(1 / (k + rank_i(d))) with smoothing constant k=60. Normalizes disparately scaled score distributions from dense cosine similarity and sparse BM25.

nodes.label: Flashcard: RRF Mathematical Formulation
nodes.panel_payload:
Q: Why is RRF preferred over weighted linear combination of scores in hybrid search?
A: Linear combination is sensitive to uncalibrated probability thresholds. RRF operates purely on ordinal rank positions, making it invariant to arbitrary scoring scales.

nodes.label: 3. Evidence Verification Engine (Post-Generation NLI)
nodes.panel_payload: The core differentiator of VERITAS: a secondary post-generation pipeline that evaluates LLM response assertions against retrieved chunk bounding boxes, producing deterministic entailment confidence metrics.

nodes.label: 3.1 Directional Natural Language Inference (NLI)
nodes.panel_payload: Deconstructs responses into atomic propositions. Each proposition is independently assessed against premise chunks to classify entailment state: FULLY_ENTAILED, PARTIALLY_ENTAILED, or UNGROUNDED_HALLUCINATION.

nodes.label: Flashcard: Strict Abstention Protocol
nodes.panel_payload:
Q: What is the deterministic response when zero retrieved chunks support a user's research query?
A: The assistant issues an unambiguous abstention: 'This is not mentioned in the provided research corpus.', preventing speculative hallucination.

nodes.label: 4. Relational Knowledge Graph & Cross-Paper Topology
nodes.panel_payload: Extracts typed scientific entities (Methodologies, Benchmark Datasets, Mathematical Models, Authors) and builds multi-tenant relational citation and contradiction topologies.

nodes.label: 4.1 Multi-Hop Adjacency Traversal
nodes.panel_payload: Enables multi-hop discovery across paper boundaries. Researchers can discover shared benchmark datasets, diverging empirical results, and author lineage through relational edge queries.

nodes.label: Flashcard: Cross-Paper Contradiction Detection
nodes.panel_payload:
Q: How does the literature matrix identify conflicting scientific findings across uploaded papers?
A: It extracts normalized metric deltas and evaluates polar assertion directionality over common experimental setups.

nodes.label: 5. Autonomous AI Research Agent & ReAct State Machine
nodes.panel_payload: Bounded multi-step research agent that executes iterative workspace searches, deep chunk reads, multi-paper synthesis, and automatic entailment verification without human intervention.

nodes.label: 5.1 Deterministic Loop Cutoff (Max 5 Steps)
nodes.panel_payload: Implements an explicit state machine preventing unbounded execution loops. The agent operates under a strict budget of at most 5 Thought-Action-Observation iterations before forced report synthesis.

nodes.label: Flashcard: Agent ReAct Decision Cycle
nodes.panel_payload:
Q: What tools are available to the autonomous research agent?
A: search_workspace, read_document_section, extract_document_summary, and finish_research. All tool invocations are logged via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

nodes.label: 5.2 Immutable Compliance & Access Auditing
nodes.panel_payload: Append-only database logging capturing document views, downloads, semantic retrievals, and prompt injection security incidents in compliance with SOC 2 CC7.2 standards.

nodes.label: Flashcard: GDPR Article 17 Erasure Cascade
nodes.panel_payload:
Q: What occurs during a user account erasure execution?
A: All owned workspaces, physical PDF files on disk, Qdrant vector collections, and chat histories are permanently purged while gracefully unlinking shared collaborative memberships.
